title: Drone Cinematography

description: I design automation workflows with n8n, OpenAI and Claude Code. One system cuts video montages for YouTube and TikTok in Final Cut Pro, another researches topics, writes SEO optimized articles, formats them and picks the right images before publishing, and a third turns manuscripts into narrated audiobooks with local text to speech.

title: Music Production

description: My digital art portfolio, which includes a wide collection of graphic designs, 3D models and short video animations created for various purposes. I have long experience working with popular softwares like Adobe Photoshop, After Effects, Premiere Pro and Blender.
